name: My Year in Pixels - CLY Pixel

ios.desc:
My Year in Pixels, CLY Pixel - A simple bullet journal app that could easily track your daily life with pixels.

Have you ever wondered how to record your year in a simple and fun way? CLY Pixel provides a new approach—visualizing your daily habits with pixel grids!

** Core Features:
- Yearly Visualization: Display 365 days of records in a pixel grid, with multiple theme options including standard yearly grids, heart-shaped grids, and more.
- Customizable Themes: Choose your preferred colors and shapes to record each moment of your life.
- Bullet journaling ideas: Many bullet journaling ideas for your daily recording in this app, you cuold easily pick one bullet journaling idea to start your journal.
- Multiple Trackers: Create and manage different record sets to track various aspects of life, such as exercise, mood, learning, and habits.
- Personalized Settings: Customize colors and themes to create your own unique annual tracker.

** Perfect for:
- Tracking daily exercise, mood, learning progress, and habits.
- Building habits and identifying patterns in daily life.
- Creating an annual summary and sharing your life story.

** Bullet journaling ideas for the year overview in pixels:
 - Mood Tracker: Color-code your emotions each day and spot trends over time.
 - Habit Tracker: Build consistency by tracking habits like reading, exercise, or meditation.
 - Gratitude Journal: Record one thing you’re grateful for each day.
 - Sleep Tracker: Monitor your sleep patterns and improve your rest quality.
 - Water Intake Tracker: Stay hydrated by tracking your daily water consumption.
 - Productivity Tracker: Keep track of your focus levels and work progress.
 - Workout Log: Log your daily exercise routine to stay motivated.
 - Book & Movie Tracker: Record what you’ve read or watched throughout the year.
 - Self-Care Tracker: Make sure you're taking time for yourself with self-care check-ins.
 - Energy Levels Tracker: Notice patterns in your energy fluctuations over the year.
 - Anxiety Tracker: Monitor stress levels and identify triggers to improve mental well-being.
 - Mindfulness Journal: Log meditation, gratitude, or self-reflection to stay mentally clear.
 - Quit Tracker: Keep track of your journey to quit smoking, drinking, or other habits.
 - Sober Streak: Record alcohol-free days and celebrate milestones in your sobriety journey.

quotes.text:
Hey HN!

I built CLY Pixel, a simple and fun way to track your daily habits, mood, and activities using a pixel grid. Each day is a tap, and by the end of the year, you get a unique, colorful visualization of your life.

Features:

1. Yearly Visualization – 365 days in a grid with multiple themes (standard, heart-shaped, etc.).

2. Custom Colors & Themes – Personalize your tracker to make it uniquely yours.

3. Multiple Trackers – Log different aspects like exercise, mood, or learning.

4. Privacy First – All data stays on your device, no tracking at all.

Would love feedback and suggestions! Let me know what you think.
